meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 可以搜索你过去所有会话的记忆库:先搜出带编号的索引,再看某条记录前后的上下文,然后按编号取完整详情,必要时才调出最原始的工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问的是历史会话而非当前对话时触发,比如“这个我们以前解决过吗”“上次 X 是怎么做的”“上周发生了什么”。

say.text: 上周那个登录报错我们是怎么解决的?
say.note: Claude 会先搜索记忆库,列出带编号的索引

say.text: 搜索记忆里 authentication 相关记录,只列最近 20 条
say.note: 用 query 和 limit 参数缩小范围

say.text: 拉出编号 11131 前后各 3 条的上下文
say.note: 用 timeline 看该记录前后的会话与提示

howto.what_en: Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: first get an index of IDs, then view context around a hit, then fetch full details by ID, and only rarely pull raw tool input/output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current conversation, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?".

say_en.text: How did we fix that login error last week?
say_en.note: Claude searches memory first and lists an index with IDs

say_en.text: Search memory for authentication records, latest 20 only
say_en.note: Narrows results with the query and limit parameters

say_en.text: Show the context around record 11131, 3 items each side
say_en.note: Uses timeline to show sessions and prompts nearby
